topics.name: Gold
topics.brief: Vietnamese and global gold prices and why they moved. One Vietnamese article on the domestic move and one on the global move. No price predictions or 'should you buy' pieces.

topics.name: Bất động sản Việt Nam
topics.brief: Policy, credit and mortgage rates, real price and transaction data, supply. Nam does not own a home yet, so buyer-relevant facts matter most. Skip project advertorials, PR and listings.

topics.name: Child care · 18 months
topics.brief: Research, pediatric guidance or safety notices relevant to a toddler around 18 months: sleep, food, language, development, health. Prefer AAP, WHO, journals, university news and quality science journalism. Skip influencer listicles and product pitches.

topics.name: Engineering & architecture
topics.brief: Substantive engineering and architecture writing: real system design case studies, migrations with numbers, design and testing practice. Good sources: InfoQ, real companies' engineering blogs, martinfowler.com, The Pragmatic Engineer.

topics.name: AI stack & practice
topics.brief: Practical AI engineering: coding agents in real use, testing AI-written code, tooling, model or stack changes that affect builders, cost. Good sources: Simon Willison, InfoQ, Latent Space, official engineering posts. Skip hype, funding news and leaderboard listicles.

topics.name: Podcasts worth your time
topics.brief: Long, in-depth episodes on software engineering, system design, architecture or AI practice. Quality bar: Beyond Coding's 'Why The Best Software Engineers Focus On System Design'. Good sources: The Pragmatic Engineer, InfoQ Podcast, Software Engineering Radio, Beyond Coding, Latent Space, CaSE.
